artworks.title: No Hay Quien Los Socorra (Nobody Can Help Them)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with burin and burnishing on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures in distress on a barren landscape. The textured background conveys a sense of desolation and bleakness. The figures appear weary and despairing, some lying on the ground while one stands cloaked in a shroud, evoking solitude and helplessness. The composition emphasizes the stark reality of their situation, with muted, earthy tones contributing to the somber mood.

artworks.title: Shipping Scene with Man-of-War
artworks.artist: Elisha Kirkall after Willem van de Velde the Younger
artworks.medium: mezzotint and etching printed in green and black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a maritime scene with sailing ships on the water. The horizon is low, and various vessels are present, suggesting a naval standoff. A ship with billowing sails is prominent in the foreground, with other ships in the distance partially obscured by smoke. The water is depicted with swirling brushstrokes, creating a sense of movement. The color palette is mainly blues and greens, with an overcast sky and soft clouds merging with the sea.

artworks.title: Shipping Scene from the Collection of Alexander Nisbit
artworks.artist: Elisha Kirkall after Willem van de Velde the Elder
artworks.medium: mezzotint and etching printed in green and black on laid paper
artworks.description: This image shows a seascape from a high vantage point. A serene horizon sits about one-third from the top. Large clouds are on the left. Various sailing ships are on calm waters, their sails catching the wind. The brushstrokes are soft and delicate, creating a tranquil scene. The color palette is muted with teal and gray dominating. Two figures are on the shoreline, and more vessels are in the distance. One ship emits smoke, hinting at activity. The composition balances human activity with the vast sea and sky.

artworks.title: Shipping Scene from the Collection of Philip Hollingworth
artworks.artist: Elisha Kirkall after Willem van de Velde the Elder
artworks.medium: mezzotint and etching printed in green and black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a naval scene with a sea battle seen from an elevated perspective. The horizon is high, obscured by smoke and clouds. A ship is on fire on the left surrounded by smaller boats. The scene shows movement and chaos through brushstrokes or engraving lines, with detailed smoke and waves. The color palette is subdued with primarily green and gray shades, creating a somber atmosphere. In the distance, other ships are sailing, suggesting a fleet in battle.

artworks.title: Dying Soldiers by the Roadside
artworks.medium: etching on cream laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a street view with various figures engaged in different activities, captured from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is high in the sky with minimally detailed clouds. The artwork uses intricate line work and cross-hatching techniques for texture and depth in architectural details and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic with strong contrasts of dark and light, typical of an etching or ink drawing. People interact near a thatched structure in the foreground, while further back, buildings, trees, and more figures populate the scene, creating depth and narrative movement.

artworks.title: Scene of Pillage
artworks.medium: etching on cream laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures in a skirmish near a large rustic structure. The horizon is in the middle, with trees receding into the distance. Trees frame the path leading to distant marching figures. There are no buildings on the horizon. The illustration uses intricate lines for detail, with crosshatching for shadows and depth. The color palette is black and white. Closest to us, figures wield poles in a lively scene. In the distance, marching figures are set against the sky and trees.

artworks.title: Savoy Pigeons
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a sketch depicting a bridge from an elevated viewpoint. The horizon line is high in the image, marked by trees and structures blending into the sky. The bridge is a central element dividing the composition, stretching horizontally across the scene. Loose brushstrokes imply clouds in the sky above the horizon. The color palette is monochromatic, using graphite or charcoal shades on a light background. Closest to us are figures on the bridge railing, suggesting a relaxed setting. In the distance, there is a tower among trees and structures, partially obscured by the sky brushwork.

artworks.title: Chelsea Bridge and Church
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The sketch shows an elevated view overlooking a body of water with two boats and their masts in the foreground. The horizon line is in the upper third, with buildings, trees, and a tower-like structure in silhouette. A bridge can be seen in the distance. The sketch is rendered in pencil or ink with a limited color palette of black, gray, and cream.

artworks.title: Millbank
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside view from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is at the top, with industrial buildings and structures along the riverbank, including chimneys emitting smoke and a distant tower-like structure. The artist uses fine lines and cross-hatching to create shadows and texture, depth, and detail. The color palette is monochromatic, using blacks and greys against the light background of the paper. Two figures stand on the shore, while another walks along a dock near a boat. Piers line the river, leading the eye toward the skyline outlined with sharp, precise lines.

artworks.title: Annie Seated
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a girl seated with her hands folded in her lap, in a chair slightly turned to the left. She has long hair, is wearing a long-sleeved dress and has her eyes closed or lowered. The background is minimal.

artworks.title: Little Putney No. 1
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a body of water, a bridge, and a church tower in the distance. The horizon aligns with the top of the bridge and buildings. Delicate sketch-like strokes create an impressionistic effect, seen in the water reflections and foliage. The color palette is mostly sepia, giving a vintage look. Water reflects structures with thin, horizontal lines. In the distance, a bridge spans left to right and a church tower rises to the right, framed by trees.

artworks.title: Sketching, No. 1
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on chine collé
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated by a calm riverbank with a sketchbook. Tall grasses and plants surround the figure, who is facing away from us, looking at the landscape. Trees stand on the opposite bank, reflected in the water. Beyond the trees are rolling hills with sparse vegetation. The artist used loose ink strokes for the trees and foliage. The color scheme is black and white, adding depth and contrast. The horizon line is slightly below center.

artworks.title: Billingsgate
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor scene with figures on a dock engaging in various activities. A building with a clock tower is to the left, and a fleet of sailing ships is moored along the water's edge. In the background, a bridge spans the view, and the sky is filled with fine, horizontal lines resembling clouds. The color palette is sepia and black, emphasizing detailed linework typical of etching, capturing a maritime environment with a sense of craftsmanship.

artworks.title: Rag Pickers, Quartier Mouffetard, Paris
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene featuring two figures by a table. The scene depicts a narrow space with rough, textured walls. On the left, there is a hanging cloth. The floor has linear hatching patterns resembling wood texture. The atmosphere is grimy with dark shadows emphasizing the environment. The figures are near the table, set against a shadowed background. The composition is framed by aged walls, capturing a daily occurrence within the space.

artworks.title: Nursemaids: "Les Bonnes du Luxembourg"
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a lightly sketched scene from a slightly elevated point of view, depicting a park setting with various figures dispersed across. The horizon is marked by a line of trees with faint architectural details. The sketch features sparse, soft pencil strokes forming figures and elements of the scenery in a monochromatic color palette of shades of gray on a neutral background. Different people are shown seated, standing, conversing, or strolling around, giving a sense of leisure and socialization.

artworks.title: Three Oriental Figures (Jacob and Laban?)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: Three figures and a dog are depicted at full length. The figures are standing outside a building. One figure is under an archway slightly facing the other two. The figures have detailed features including beards and mustaches, and wear head coverings and robes with intricate patterns. One figure is gesturing. A small dog is sitting nearby. In the background, there is an architectural structure with an arch and a decorated column. Leafy vines are in the top left. The scene is sketched with fine lines and shading, creating a detailed representation.

artworks.title: The Circumcision in the Stable
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with a group of figures gathered in a dimly lit space. The image shows several figures clustered around a central point of interest, with their attention focused intently. The composition is dense with lines and hatching to create depth and shadow, adding to the overall somber and intimate atmosphere. A ladder leans against an interior wall, suggesting a rustic or simple setting. The use of cross-hatching and tonal contrasts enhances the dramatic mood of the scene.

artworks.title: Out of Study Window
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape seen from an elevated position overlooking a city. The horizon is low in the composition, allowing a large expanse of sky to dominate the scene. Along the horizon are buildings and spires indicating an urban area expanding across the landscape. The art style includes detailed line work with cross-hatching to create texture, particularly in the sky filled with swirling cumulonimbus clouds. The color scheme is monochromatic, with various shades of black, white, and gray enhancing contrast and detail, with the sky standing out against the intricate cityscape below. Trees and vegetation in the foreground frame the city, providing depth and perspective. The city extends into the distance, appearing subdued beneath the dramatic sky.

artworks.title: Plate 32: Close, No. 128 Saltmarket
artworks.medium: carbon print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a narrow alleyway with stone buildings on either side and a staircase leading up to a balcony. The alley is framed by tall stone structures with numerous windows. The wooden stairs on the right-hand side ascend steeply to a platform. Above the alley, laundry is strung across a clothesline. The ground is cobbled and slightly uneven. The photograph captures a scene with clouded skies visible between the buildings. The textures of the stone, wood, and rusticated surfaces contribute to a dramatic quality in the image.

artworks.title: Saint-Cloud
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a large tree, a stone statue of a figure with a cross, distant leafless trees, a reflective body of water, and a misty horizon. The color palette is soft sepia tones, with bare earth, small heaps, and an overcast sky.

artworks.title: Saint-Cloud
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a park landscape with a tree and a statue close to the viewer. The scene includes an ornamental pond and pathway, surrounded by rows of trees in the distance. The sky appears hazy, suggesting an early spring or late autumn setting. The image has a sepia-toned palette, with soft, diffused light creating contrast between the foreground silhouettes and the background.

artworks.title: Maison à  Versailles
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a building facade. The image features a two-story structure with a number "5" displayed on a sign above the wooden double doors and on a plaque beside an open window. The ground floor has large windows with intricate glasswork and a combination of wood paneling and brick. The street in front is paved with cobblestones. The building has a symmetrical design, with window shutters and bold numbers.

artworks.title: Abbaye du Gard pres d' Abbeville
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a large building with a gabled roof and windows in the distance, along with adjacent trees. Nearby is a church-like structure with a steeple partly hidden by trees. In the forefront, there are rows of cultivated plants, potentially a vineyard, divided by wooden fencing. Closest to the viewer are railway tracks running horizontally across the scene. The color scheme consists of sepia and gray tones typical of an old photograph, evoking a vintage and nostalgic atmosphere.

artworks.title: L' Isle Adam
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This image shows a riverside scene with a broad expanse of water dominating the foreground. Distant trees and buildings soften the horizon line. A small weir is visible in the distance, cutting across the river. On the right side, there are quaint buildings among trees, some structures slightly rising above the tree line. The scene is rendered in warm sepia tones, typical of early photography, creating a nostalgic atmosphere. The water's surface is smooth and reflective, and there are some indistinct small structures on the grassy area to the left.
